name: Media
description: One window for the streaming services you pay for, and a player for your own IPTV subscription. Nothing is downloaded, nothing is re-streamed, and no DRM is bundled: each service opens in Firefox, which fetches Widevine itself if you let it.
hints: Services are launched into one Firefox profile so every login is kept in one place. IPTV talks to the provider the user entered and hands the stream to Haruna.
